cases.name: Toni Renee Ladd
cases.about: Her obituary said she was a kind hearted, genuine woman with an infectious smile and a laugh that would brighten a room. She enjoyed warm days, cruising in her jeep with the top down and walking barefoot on the beach. Her greatest joy however was caring for people and spending time with her precious grandchildren.
